rule.description: A definition with internal (file-local) linkage in the extension's single translation unit that no externally visible entry point can ever reach, directly or transitively (including through other internal definitions, initializers, hook tables, macro expansions, and under supported optional build configurations). Branch guards controlled by internal configuration scalars that are compile-time constants and are never assigned anywhere are treated as never taken, exactly as the produced extension behaves.

checks.description: Internal-linkage definitions that no externally visible entry point of the extension can ever reach under supported uses and configurations. Detected with the Clang-Tidy backend: the clang-tidy binary analyzes the translation unit with the extension's include and flag configuration and supplies its unused-internal-definition diagnostics, and a Clang-AST reachability pass over the same parsed translation unit decides which internal definitions remain unreachable, treating compile-time-constant never-assigned guard scalars as making their guarded branches permanently unreachable.
checks.detected_relation: internal-linkage definition -> no reachable path from any external-linkage entry point
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The definition is compiled and maintained as part of the extension but no supported option, command, SQL surface, or optional build flag can ever execute it: obsolete implementation retained without a role under supported uses and configurations, whose removal is mandatory and behavior-preserving.

matches.evidence: Internal spec string referenced only from the unreachable legacy quantization helper (E01); unreachable internal variable.

File-scope internal selection switch with a compile-time-constant 0 initializer; its only reads are the condition of a guard inside the live entry point vec_quantize_int8 (E05), so the guarded legacy body is permanently unreachable. No supported option, command, or registration ever assigns it.
Helper called only from the unreachable legacy quantization helper (E01); no reachable path.
Legacy quantization mode reachable only through the never-taken guard in vec_quantize_int8, whose controlling switch is a compile-time constant no supported surface can set.
Called only from vec_serialize_element (E07), itself reachable only from vec_serialize_recursive (E08); the three form a closed internal cycle with no entry from any external-linkage root.
Member of a mutually recursive internal cycle (E06, E07, E08); neither its sole caller (E08) nor any other root can be reached from supported behavior.
Cycle top of the recursive internal serializer; the live single-pass JSON builder does not call into it.
File-scope policy table read only by the unreachable retraining helpers (E09, E10); no reachable reader.

Called only from ivf_retrain_chunk (E10), which is reached only inside the internal retraining cycle (E09, E10, E11); no IVF maintenance root enters the cycle, even with the experimental IVF build flag enabled.
Mutually recursive with ivf_retrain_sweep (E11); the cycle has no reachable entry under supported configurations.
Cycle member with no root path; the supported rebuild-on-invalidation maintenance path clears centroids without it.

Original random seeding consumed by nothing; the live clustering path seeds through the k-means++ initializer instead. Reported by the Clang-Tidy backend's clang-diagnostic-unused-function diagnostic on the translation unit.
Called only from the draft top-level packer rescore_pack_v1_chunk (E14), itself unreachable; supported chunk storage uses the zeroblob path.
Called only from the same unreachable draft packer (E14); survives only inside the dead chain rooted at it.
Root of the abandoned chunk-packing draft; no insert/update path calls it. Reported by the Clang-Tidy backend's clang-diagnostic-unused-function diagnostic on the translation unit.
Listed only in the internal rebuild-strategy hook table (E20), which nothing reads; no command verb selects a strategy, even though the table's presence looks like a registration.
Second strategy entry of the same unreferenced hook table (E20); equally unreachable.
Cost estimate helper called only by the two unreachable strategy handlers (E17, E18).
File-scope internal strategy table referenced by no supported code: the appearance of a dispatch registration does not create reachability, and the handlers exist only as its initializers.

excluded.location: externally visible vec0 virtual table methods, registered SQL functions, and extension entry point
excluded.reason: External-linkage roots of the reachability analysis; by definition reachable surface, never flagged.

excluded.location: internal helpers reached through command/argument dispatch tables that live supported code actually walks
excluded.reason: Load-bearing dispatch differs from the unreferenced hook table: a supported command verb walks them, so they are reachable and excluded.

excluded.location: experimental IVF and rescore definitions reachable when SQLITE_VEC_EXPERIMENTAL_IVF_ENABLE or SQLITE_VEC_ENABLE_RESCORE are enabled
excluded.reason: Optional build configurations are supported uses; the rule analyzes the translation unit with those flags enabled, so such definitions are reachable and excluded.

excluded.location: macro constants and file-scope tables read by supported code
excluded.reason: Reachable through live readers; not part of the smell relation.
